slides.title: A Wavefunction That Evolves
slides.caption: i\hbar\frac{\partial \psi(x,t)}{\partial t}=\left[-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m}\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x^2}+V(x,t)\right]\psi(x,t)\quad\text{with dynamic amplitude scaling}
slides.narration: The wavefunction evolves according to the Schrödinger equation. Watch its amplitude rescale dynamically while the wavelength and phase structure remain clear.
